primary_bug.summary: The rewrite loses the old 'searched, not found' sentinel, making the re-added Debug.Assert a wrong invariant that terminates debug-build processes. Old code initialized `_rowidOrdinal = -1` before the scan, so `Debug.Assert(_rowidOrdinal.HasValue)` was vacuously true and the not-found case flowed to the `< 0` MemoryStream fallback. New code leaves `rowIdForOrdinal` null when the scan finds no rowid column for the blob's (database, table) — expression columns with no backing table (e.g. `SELECT 'test'`), queries that don't select the table's INTEGER PK/rowid, composite-PK or WITHOUT ROWID tables — and then `Debug.Assert(rowIdForOrdinal != null)` FIRES, killing the process in Debug builds (xUnit run: 'Process terminated. Assertion failed.' at SqliteDataRecord.cs:393, test GetFieldValue_of_TextReader_works doing `SELECT 'test'`, via GetTextReader → GetStream). In Release the assert compiles out and the null correctly falls back to MemoryStream, so the defect is the assertion itself asserting a state that is legitimately reachable.
primary_bug.locus: GetStream ~L326-395: `if (!RowIds.TryGetValue(rowidkey, out rowIdForOrdinal)) { ...scan... Debug.Assert(rowIdForOrdinal!=null); }` — the assert after the scan loop.
primary_bug.must_flag: A reviewer catches the primary bug if it flags that `Debug.Assert(rowIdForOrdinal != null)` can fire — i.e., that 'no rowid column found' is a legitimate, reachable outcome of the scan (expression/computed columns with no table, PK not in the select list, WITHOUT ROWID or composite-PK tables) and the new code asserts it cannot happen, crashing Debug builds / the test suite, whereas the old `-1` sentinel encoded not-found as a valid asserted state. Equivalent formulations count: 'the assert is no longer vacuously true / the invariant is wrong', 'null is a legal post-loop state so the assert will fail on non-table columns', 'Debug.Assert semantics changed from HasValue (always true) to found (not always true)'. Merely noting the null-fallback branch exists, or that the not-found result is never cached (perf), does NOT count — the crash-on-assert facet must be named.

known_safe.summary: The `if (rowIdForOrdinal == null) return new MemoryStream(GetCachedBlob(ordinal), false);` branch means there is NO null-dereference at `rowIdForOrdinal.Ordinal` — claiming an NRE on the later use is refuted; null is checked before use. (The defect is the Debug.Assert above it, not a missing null check below.)

The scan loop DOES filter candidate columns by database name and table name (pre-existing `if (databaseName != blobDatabaseName) continue;` and `if (tableName != blobTableName) continue;` lines, unchanged by the diff) before the rowid/PK checks — claiming 'another table's rowid/PK could be picked for this blob' is refuted. The pkColumns memoization is also safe: every column reaching it belongs to blobTableName.

RowIds is a readonly INSTANCE field on SqliteDataRecord (one per query execution), not static — claims of cross-query cache poisoning, unbounded growth across statements, or thread-shared state are refuted. It lives and dies with the data record.
